name: spellkave_pace_time
label: Spellkave Pace Time
description: Pause, resume, step or change the shared clock interval as the caller. Requires a live frontier.pace_time grant and the caller world-connection port; publisher connections are refused. Step accepts ticks (default 1); interval requires seconds within publisher-configured bounds. Returns correlated event id and clock state. Hosted capability routing is supplied by authority-tools-over-mcp.
